2. Incorporate the liquid extracts, fragrance, and solubilizer, blending by hand until the texture resembles damp sand.
3. Compact the mixture firmly into spherical moulds and allow to harden for 24 hours.
4. Unmould the bombs and roll them in iridescent mica until fully coated, brushing off any excess.
5. Optionally, blend multiple mica shades onto the surface for a pearl-like finish.

recipes.name: Coconut & Cocoa Body Solution
recipes.description: Slow-fizzing bath truffles featuring lavender mica and a calming essential oil blend. Formulated with high levels of butters for a moisturizing and aromatic bath lather.
recipes.process:
1. Whisk the baking soda and citric acid in a large bowl until clump-free. Wear gloves to protect against acidity.
2. Incorporate the oil phase into the dry ingredients and blend thoroughly by hand.
3. Divide the mixture into two portions and color one with lavender mica.
4. Combine a small amount of each color and squeeze into spherical balls.
5. Allow the truffles to harden for 48 hours in a cool, dry location.

recipes.name: Coconut & About 9 Ml Polysorbate 80 Body Effervescent
recipes.description: Moon-shaped bath bombs featuring coconut oil and a sophisticated fragrance. Designed for high effervescence and a moisturizing, skin-softening bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the coconut oil using short microwave bursts.
2. Incorporate the fragrance and solubilizer into the melted oil.
3. Add the oil mixture to the dry base ingredients and blend with gloved hands until uniform.
4. Compact the mixture firmly into moon-shaped moulds, ensuring the mould is filled only to the inner lip.
5. Allow to dry for at least 4 hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Coconut Body Effervescent
recipes.description: Intricately designed bath bombs featuring reflective gold mica and coconut oil. Designed for high effervescence and a tropical-themed, mineral-rich bath soak.
recipes.process:
1. Whisk the dry base ingredients and gold mica in a large bowl.
2. Melt the coconut oil and incorporate the fragrance and solubilizer.
3. Combine the oil mixture with the powders and blend until the texture is homogeneous.
4. Press firmly into sand-dollar moulds and allow to dry for 24 hours.
5. Unmould and decorate the surface with white mica paint to highlight the central star design.

recipes.name: Slsa & Shea Body Solution
recipes.description: Bi-colored bubbling bath truffles featuring aqua mica and pink sea salt. Formulated with cocoa and shea butters for a moisturizing, foam-rich bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the butter phase in a water bath and incorporate the fragrance, humectants, and mica shimmer.
2. Divide the dry base into two portions and color one with aqua mica.
3. Gradually add the liquid mixture to the dry portions, blending until a dough is formed.
4. Flatten the white dough onto the blue dough and roll into a bi-colored log.
5. Sprinkle with pink sea salt and cut into individual bars.
6. Allow to harden for 48 hours before use.

recipes.name: Coconut & Polysorbate 80 Body Effervescent
recipes.description: Elegant rose-gold themed bath bombs featuring coconut oil and pink sea salt. Designed for a high-effervescence soak with a sophisticated floral scent.
recipes.process:
1. Mix coarse pink sea salt with rose-gold mica and place a small portion at the bottom of the moulds.
2. Whisk the dry base ingredients and fine salt together in a large bowl.
3. Melt the coconut oil and incorporate the fragrance and solubilizer.
4. Combine the phases and blend with gloved hands, spritzing with witch hazel until the mixture holds its shape.
5. Fill the moulds firmly and allow to dry for at least 4 hours.

recipes.name: Slsa & Shea Body Solution
recipes.description: Multi-colored bubbling bath truffles featuring a rainbow of micas. Formulated with shea and cocoa butters for a moisturizing, foam-heavy bath treatment.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the butter phase in a water bath and incorporate the fragrance, humectants, and solubilizer.
2. Divide the dry base into seven portions and color each with a different rainbow mica.
3. Work the liquid mixture into each portion to create seven colored doughs.
4. Flatten each color into a log and stack them sequentially, pressing them together into a single large log.
5. Twist the log carefully if a swirled effect is desired, then press into a mould or cut into bars.
6. Allow to harden for 48–72 hours.

recipes.name: Cocoa & Shea Body Solution
recipes.description: Fragrant lilac-themed bath truffles featuring dried rose petals and pink micas. Formulated with unrefined butters for high emolliency and a soft bath lather.
recipes.process:
1. Whisk the dry base ingredients in a large bowl until smooth.
2. Melt the cocoa and shea butters together using short microwave bursts.
3. Incorporate the fragrance and stir until uniform.
4. Pour the melted butter mixture into the powders and blend with gloved hands.
5. Add the micas and dried flower petals, mixing thoroughly before shaping into truffles.

recipes.name: Meadowfoam & Cocoa Body Effervescent
recipes.description: Opulent bath bombs featuring a full coating of metallic gold mica. Formulated for high effervescence and a luxurious, skin-softening bath experience with a champagne scent.
recipes.process:
1. Whisk the dry base ingredients in a large bowl. Wear gloves to protect skin from citric acid.
2. Incorporate the liquid carrier oils, colorants, and fragrance, blending thoroughly until uniform.
3. Spritz with witch hazel until the mixture reaches a "wet sand" consistency.
4. Compress firmly into moulds and allow to dry for 24 hours.
5. Lightly spritz the dry bombs with alcohol and roll in gold mica until fully coated.

recipes.name: Shea & Jojoba Body Solution
recipes.description: Multi-layered bath bombs featuring a hidden colored core. Formulated with shea butter and jojoba oil for high emolliency and a playful, fizzing surprise.
recipes.process:
1. Whisk the dry base ingredients and arrowroot powder together.
2. Melt the shea butter and carrier oils, then incorporate the colorant and fragrance.
3. Blend the liquid phase into the dry phase using a stand mixer until uniform.
4. Scoop the mixture into a meat-baller to create mini bath bombs and allow them to dry for 24 hours.
5. Create a secondary batch of white mixture. Place a mini bomb inside a larger mould and fill the surrounding space with the white mixture.
6. Compress firmly and allow to dry for another 24 hours.

recipes.name: Shea & Cocoa Body Cream
recipes.description: A bi-colored bubbling bath truffle featuring unrefined cocoa butter and shea oil. Scented with orange and vanilla for a moisturizing, creamsicle-inspired bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Whisk the baking soda and citric acid in a large bowl until clump-free.
2. Melt the cocoa butter and shea oil using short microwave bursts.
3. Incorporate the fragrance and pour the butter mixture into the powders.
4. Divide the dough and color one half with orange dye.
5. Press the orange and white portions sequentially into disk moulds to create a layered effect.
6. Smooth the surface and allow to harden for 48 hours.

recipes.name: Slsa & Castor Body Solution
recipes.description: DIY How to Make Solid Bubble Bath from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Melted Cocoa & Melted Cocoa Body Bar
recipes.description: DIY Making Bath Truffles on Soap Queen TV from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Granulated Sugar & Coconut Facial Scrub
recipes.description: A rose-scented exfoliating lip scrub featuring rosehip seed oil and cocoa butter. Designed for gentle removal of dry skin and intensive lip nourishment.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the coconut oil, cocoa butter, and rosehip seed oil together using short microwave bursts until liquid.
2. Incorporate the fragrance and mica shimmer, stirring until the color is uniform.
3. Gradually add the sugar and stir until the mixture thickens into a uniform paste.
4. Transfer to small jars and allow to set.

recipes.name: Kukui Nut & Coconut Facial Balm
recipes.description: A tropical-scented lip balm featuring kukui nut oil and beeswax. Formulated for high stability and a smooth, protective finish on the lips.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the base oils and waxes in a water bath or microwave until fully liquid.
2. Remove from heat and incorporate the coconut flavor oil.
3. Stir until uniform and pour into sliding metal tins.
4. Allow the balm to solidify completely before use.

recipes.name: Coconut & White Beeswax Facial Solution
recipes.description: A vibrant orange-tinted lip balm featuring pineapple flavor and avocado oil. Formulated with white beeswax for high stability and a smooth application.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the coconut oil, cocoa butter, beeswax, and avocado oil together using short microwave bursts.
2. Incorporate the flavor oils and orange mica, stirring thoroughly to eliminate clumps.
3. Pour the liquid mixture into lip balm tubes.
4. Allow to harden for several minutes, then scrape off any excess from the tube tops.
5. Allow to cool completely before capping.

recipes.name: Suspending Nail Polish Base & Nourish Lip Balm Base Facial Solution
recipes.description: A coordinated rose-gold cosmetic set featuring eyeshadow, lip shimmer, and nail polish. Designed for a cohesive, metallic rose-gold aesthetic with high reflectivity.
recipes.process:
1. For nail polish: Add 20 scoops of rose-gold mica and one mixing ball to a clear polish base. Shake vigorously for 3–5 minutes until the mica is fully dispersed.
2. For eyeshadow and lip shimmer: Blend the base emollients with rose-gold mica until a smooth, uniform paste or powder is achieved.
3. Transfer each product to its appropriate cosmetic container.

recipes.name: Avocado & Coconut Facial Balm
recipes.description: A high-stability lip balm featuring white beeswax and protective waxes. Formulated with reflective micas for a shimmery finish, suitable for cold-weather lip protection.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the base oils and waxes in a water bath or microwave until fully liquid.
2. Remove from heat and stir in the mica shimmer until evenly distributed.
3. Incorporate the essential oils and vitamin E.
4. Pour the liquid balm into tubes and allow to solidify completely.

recipes.name: Sweet Almond & White Beeswax Facial Balm
recipes.description: DIY Labeling Your Products : Lip Balm from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt & Pour Soap Base & Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Decorative heart-themed soap bars featuring heart-shaped embeds. Formulated with goat milk soap base for a creamy lather and gentle hair and skin cleansing.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt & Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt a small portion of clear soap base with red colorant. Pour into a heart-column mould and allow to set. Unmould and cut to length for embeds.
2. Melt the goat milk soap base using short microwave bursts until liquid (approx. 130°F).
3. Incorporate the fragrance and stir thoroughly.
4. Pour a thin base layer into a loaf mould and spritz with alcohol.
5. Secure the heart embeds in the base layer, then pour the remaining white soap until the embeds are fully covered.
6. Spritz with alcohol to remove bubbles and allow to solidify completely before slicing into bars.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base & Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A vibrant orange-scented soap featuring decorative daisy embeds. Formulated with goat milk and clear soap bases for a multi-textured, effectively cleansing bath experience.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base
Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt a small portion of goat milk base and pour into daisy-column moulds. Allow to set and cut to length.
2. Melt the clear soap base and incorporate the orange essential oil.
3. Pour a base layer into a loaf mould, allow to set slightly, and position the daisy embeds.
4. Pour the remaining clear soap over the embeds and spritz with alcohol.
5. Allow to solidify completely for 24 hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour Soap Base & Honey Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A multi-layered soap featuring honey and white soap bases. Scented with a cinnamon-cocoa fragrance and formulated for a rich, creamy lather with high emolliency.

ingredients.name: White Melt And Pour Soap Base
Honey Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt the white soap base and incorporate the fragrance and color stabilizer.
2. Pour a 10 oz. layer into a loaf mould, spritz with alcohol, and allow to set for 20 minutes.
3. Melt the honey soap base and color with brown iron oxide. Add fragrance and stabilizer.
4. Pour a 10 oz. brown layer over the white layer once it has cooled to 130°F.
5. Repeat the layers sequentially, allowing each to set before the next pour.
6. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before slicing.

recipes.name: Stephenson Ultra Clear Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Luminous crystal-shaped soaps featuring ultra-clear soap base and reflective glitter. Designed for a visually striking, gem-like appearance and effective cleansing.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the clear soap base in a water bath or microwave until fully liquid.
2. Incorporate the blue colorant and silver glitter, stirring gently to minimize bubbles.
3. Pour into rectangular moulds and allow to solidify completely.
4. Unmould and use a sharp knife to hand-carve the bars into geometric gem shapes.
5. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap to prevent glycerin dew.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base & Vanilla Color Stabilizer Cleansing Cream
recipes.description: An exfoliating soap bar featuring coffee grounds and coffee seed oil. Formulated with a goat milk soap base for a creamy lather and intensive skin softening.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt the goat milk soap base using short microwave bursts.
2. Incorporate the coffee seed oil, fragrance, and color stabilizer.
3. Stir in the coffee grounds once the soap has cooled to 125°F to prevent settling.
4. Pour into silicone moulds and spritz with alcohol.
5. Allow to solidify completely for several hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A decorative ocean-themed soap featuring realistic sea floor and wave effects. Formulated with various blue-toned soap bases and exfoliating walnut shells.
recipes.process:
1. Create the ocean floor layer by mixing white soap base with walnut shells and brown oxide. Pour into a mould and use a spoon to shape peaks and divots as it sets.
2. Melt multiple portions of soap base and color with varying shades of blue and green.
3. Layer and swirl the blue-toned soaps over the textured base once they reach 125°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol after each pour to ensure layer adhesion.
5. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & Vanilla Color Stabilizer Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Unique soap bars featuring embedded natural sea sponges. Formulated with jagua blue extract for a deep-sea aesthetic and clear soap base for high transparency.
recipes.process:
1. Disperse the jagua blue extract in alcohol and stir into melted clear soap base.
2. Incorporate the fragrance and color stabilizer.
3. Fill the moulds 80% full and allow to set until a strong skin forms.
4. Reheat the remaining soap, spritz the set layer with alcohol, and fill the mould.
5. Press natural sea sponges into the liquid top layer and spritz with alcohol.
6. Allow to solidify completely for several hours.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Exfoliating loofah soaps featuring natural loofah sponges embedded in a tri-colored soap base. Scented with avocado and formulated for a deep, revitalizing cleanse.
recipes.process:
1. Hydrate the loofah sponges in water until expanded, then dry and place in moulds.
2. Melt clear and white soap bases in separate containers.
3. Incorporate tomato and spinach powders (dispersed in alcohol) into the melted bases for varying colors.
4. Pour the colored soaps into the moulds, ensuring the loofah is fully saturated.
5. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify for 24 hours.

recipes.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap Base & White Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A nutrient-rich soap bar featuring bee pollen and honey soap base. Designed for high emolliency and a natural floral fragrance.

ingredients.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap Base
White Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt a blend of honey and white soap bases using short microwave bursts.
2. Disperse the bee pollen powder in alcohol and stir into the melted base.
3. Incorporate the fragrance and blend thoroughly.
4. Pour into silicone moulds and spritz with alcohol.
5. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt & Pour Soap Base & Spearmint Essential Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A skin-softening goat milk soap featuring alfalfa powder for a natural green aesthetic. Designed for gentle hair and skin cleansing with high emolliency.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt & Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt the goat milk soap base until liquid (approx. 130°F).
2. Disperse the alfalfa powder in alcohol and stir into the melted base until no clumps remain.
3. Incorporate the essential oils and blend thoroughly.
4. Pour into moulds and spritz with alcohol to remove bubbles.
5. Allow to solidify completely before use.

recipes.name: White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Exfoliating mini soap bars featuring poppy seeds and lemon peel powder. Formulated with a white soap base for a creamy lather and a refreshing citrus scent.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the white soap base using short microwave bursts.
2. Incorporate the fragrance and stir thoroughly.
3. Add the poppy seeds and lemon peel powder, stirring until no clumps remain.
4. Verify the soap temperature is between 51–54°C (125–130°F) before pouring into moulds to prevent seed settling.
5. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify for 2–4 hours.

recipes.name: White Melt & Pour Soap Base & Spray Bottle Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A skin-softening soap bar featuring rose clay and rosehip powder. Designed for a gentle, mineral-rich cleanse with an exfoliating poppy seed texture.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the white soap base until fully liquid (approx. 130°F).
2. Disperse the rose clay and rosehip powder in alcohol and stir into the melted base.
3. Incorporate the essential oils and poppy seeds, blending thoroughly.
4. Pour into moulds and spritz with alcohol to remove bubbles.
5. Allow to solidify completely for 4 hours before cutting with a crinkle cutter.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Seasonal tri-colored soap bars featuring a candy-corn aesthetic. Formulated with white and clear soap bases for a multi-layered, festive bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Melt three portions of soap base. Color one yellow and one orange using color blocks.
2. Pour the yellow layer into a loaf mould, spritz with alcohol, and allow to set.
3. Pour the orange layer over the yellow layer once it has cooled to 130°F.
4. Repeat with the final white layer.
5. Once solidified, slice the loaf into triangular bars to mimic candy corn shapes.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: DIY Caramel Apple Soap DIY from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base & Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A high-performance soap kit featuring exfoliating walnut shells and shredded loofah. Designed for intensive hand cleaning with a skin-conditioning goat milk base.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Layer 1: Mix melted goat milk base with walnut shells and fragrance. Pour into a mould and allow to set.
2. Layer 2: Color melted goat milk base with green oxide. Pour over the first layer once cooled to 130°F.
3. Layer 3: Mix melted clear base with dark green colorant and shredded loofah. Pour over the second layer.
4. Spritz with alcohol between layers to ensure adhesion.
5. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap Base & Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A decorative swirled soap featuring honey and goat milk bases. Formulated for high emolliency and a festive, sparkling aesthetic with seasonal micas.

ingredients.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap Base
Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt one portion of goat milk base and two portions of honey soap base.
2. Color the goat milk base green and the honey bases gold and burgundy using micas.
3. Incorporate the fragrance into each portion.
4. Pour a base layer of green soap into a loaf mould, then swirl in the gold and burgundy portions while the soap is at 125°F.
5. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Crystal-shaped soaps featuring a rose-quartz aesthetic. Formulated with a blend of white and clear soap bases for a translucent, mineral-like appearance.
recipes.process:
1. Melt white and clear soap bases in separate containers.
2. Disperse rose-gold mica in alcohol and incorporate into the clear soap base.
3. Add fragrance to both bases.
4. Layer and swirl the two bases in a loaf mould to create a marbled effect.
5. Once solidified, use a sharp knife to hand-carve the bars into geometric gem shapes.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base & Orange 10x Essential Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A brightening soap bar featuring natural turmeric powder and citrus essential oils. Formulated with goat milk soap base for a creamy, skin-softening lather.

recipes.process:

2. Disperse the turmeric powder in alcohol and stir into the melted base until no clumps remain.
3. Incorporate the orange essential oil and blend thoroughly.
4. Pour into silicone moulds and spritz with alcohol.
5. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base & White Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A tri-layered floral soap featuring aqua and green clear bases. Formulated for high transparency and a sophisticated lily scent with intensive skin softening.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base
White Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Layer 1: Color melted clear base with aqua mica and fragrance. Pour into a mould and allow to set.
2. Layer 2: Melt white soap base and incorporate fragrance. Pour over the first layer once cooled to 130°F.
3. Layer 3: Color melted clear base with green mica. Pour over the white layer.
4. Spritz with alcohol between each pour to ensure layer stability.
5. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before slicing.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base & Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Decorative soap bars featuring intricate rose-clay details. Formulated with goat milk soap base for a luxurious lather and effective mineral-based cleansing.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Soap Base
Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base
Dogwood And Ginger Blossom Fragrance Oil

recipes.process:
1. Disperse rose clay in alcohol and incorporate into melted clear soap base.
2. Use a precision injector to fill the intricate details of a mould with the red clay soap.
3. Once the details have set, melt goat milk base and incorporate fragrance.
4. Pour the white soap over the set details once it has cooled to 130°F.
5. Allow to solidify for 4 hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: White Melt & Pour Soap Base & Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Whimsical animal-shaped soaps featuring multi-colored details. Formulated with goat milk and clear soap bases for a gentle, family-friendly bath experience.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt small portions of soap base and color with various dyes for animal features (face, eyes, etc.).
2. Use a precision tool to fill the detail cavities of the animal moulds.
3. Once the details have set, pour a contrasting base soap (goat milk or clear) over the top until the mould is full.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely.

recipes.name: Aloe Vera Melt And Pour & White Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A detoxifying soap bar featuring activated charcoal and tea tree essential oil. Formulated with an aloe vera soap base for a clarifying yet non-stripping cleanse.

ingredients.name: White Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Use a precision tool to fill detail cavities with white soap base. Allow to set.
2. Melt the aloe vera soap base until liquid (approx. 130°F).
3. Disperse activated charcoal in alcohol and stir into the melted base until uniform.
4. Incorporate the tea tree essential oil.
5. Pour the black soap over the set white details once it has cooled to 130°F.
6. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour Soap Base & Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A decorative tart-shaped soap featuring embedded soap blueberries. Formulated with a white soap base for a creamy aesthetic and a fruity tart fragrance.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base
White Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Create blueberry embeds by melting soap base with blue colorant and pouring into small spherical moulds.
2. Melt white soap base and incorporate fragrance.
3. Pour a base layer into a tart mould and allow to set slightly.
4. Position three blueberry embeds on top of each bar.
5. Pour the remaining white soap around the embeds and spritz with alcohol.
6. Allow to solidify completely for one hour.

recipes.name: Stephenson Ultra Clear Soap Base & Vanilla Color Stabilizer Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Deep purple soap bars featuring ultra-clear soap base and reflective glitter. Scented with plum fragrance and formulated for a dark, mysterious aesthetic with high transparency.

ingredients.name: Bramble Berry’s Alien Type Fragrance Oil

recipes.process:
1. Melt the clear soap base and color with purple and black color blocks to reach a deep plum shade.
2. Incorporate the mica shimmer and iridescent glitter, stirring until no clumps remain.
3. Add the fragrance and color stabilizer, blending thoroughly.
4. Pour into moulds and spritz with alcohol to remove bubbles.
5. Allow to solidify completely for several hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base & Vanilla Color Stabilizer Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Festive star-shaped soaps featuring a sparkly gold aesthetic. Formulated with clear soap base and a seasonal conifer scent for a radiant, skin-softening bath experience.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt the clear soap base and incorporate gold colorant until a rich sparkly shade is achieved.
2. Add the fragrance and color stabilizer.
3. Pour into star-shaped silicone moulds and spritz with alcohol.
4. Allow to solidify completely before use.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base & White Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Multi-colored swirled soaps featuring a vibrant cotton candy aesthetic. Formulated with white and clear soap bases for a professional, multi-textured finish with reflective glitter.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base
White Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt portions of white and clear soap bases. Color with pastel pink, hot pink, pastel blue, and vibrant blue dyes.
2. Incorporate fine iridescent glitter into the clear soap portions.
3. Add cotton candy fragrance and color stabilizer to all containers.
4. Sequentially pour and swirl the colored soaps into a loaf mould, alternating opaque and transparent shades at 125°F.
5. Allow to solidify for at least 5 hours before slicing into bars.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & Goat Milk Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Decorative tart-shaped soap bars featuring multi-colored red and pink layers. Formulated for a high-lather experience and a festive berry aesthetic.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt clear and white soap bases. Color portions red and pink using dyes.
2. Layer the red and pink soaps sequentially in tart moulds, allowing each layer to set and spritzing with alcohol between pours.
3. Once the final layer is poured, position a soap berry embed in the center of each bar.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Seasonal snowflake-themed soaps featuring ultra-clear soap base and reflective micas. Designed for a slow, luxurious fizz and high skin softening.
recipes.process:
1. Melt a small portion of clear soap base and color with blue mica. Use for fine snowflake details.
2. Melt the main clear soap base and incorporate snowflake sparkle and white micas.
3. Add the fragrance and stir thoroughly.
4. Pour the white soap into snowflake moulds and spritz with alcohol.
5. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap & White Melt And Pour Soap Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Intricate bee-shaped soaps featuring multi-colored honey and black details. Formulated with a honey soap base for high emolliency and a natural floral fragrance.
recipes.process:
1. Color a small portion of honey soap base with black oxide. Fill the bee stripe details using a precision tool.
2. Melt white soap base, color yellow, and fill the bee body cavities.
3. Melt the remaining honey soap base and color with gold micas. Pour over the set details once cooled to 125°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to harden for several hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base & Vanilla Color Stabilizer Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A seasonal maple-scented soap featuring red, orange, and yellow swirled layers. Formulated for a rich, creamy lather with high emolliency.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt clear soap base and incorporate gold mica, maple fragrance, and color stabilizer.
2. Divide the soap into three portions and color with red, orange, and yellow oxides.
3. Sequentially pour and swirl the colored soaps into leaf-shaped moulds.
4. Spritz with alcohol after each pour to ensure layer adhesion.
5. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: A decorative honeycomb-themed soap featuring gold-toned honey soap base. Designed for high emolliency and a natural, sweet honey fragrance.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the honey soap base and incorporate gold mica and honey fragrance.
2. Verify the soap temperature is below 130°F to prevent detail melting.
3. Pour the liquid soap into honeycomb-textured moulds.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely for several hours.
5. Wrap in plastic wrap to prevent glycerin dew.

recipes.name: Stephenson Ultra Clear Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Whimsical clear soap bars featuring embedded toy fish. Formulated with ultra-clear soap base for high transparency and a fresh apple fragrance.

ingredients.name: Stephenson Ultra Clear Melt And Pour Base
Apple Macintosh Candle & Soap Fragrance Oil

recipes.process:
1. Melt the clear soap base and incorporate blue colorant, glitter, and fragrance.
2. Allow the soap to cool to 135°F to avoid damaging the toy embeds.
3. Pour the liquid soap into individual plastic bags.
4. Drop 1–3 toy fish into each bag and secure the tops with a clip.
5. Lay the bags on their side to position the fish and allow to set for 10 minutes.
6. Peel away the plastic once the soap is fully solidified.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Butter
recipes.description: Floral-themed soaps featuring embedded daisy designs. Formulated with clear and white soap bases for a multi-textured, effectively cleansing bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Create daisy embeds using yellow and white soap bases in column moulds. Cut to length.
2. Melt clear soap base and color with blue mica and floral fragrance.
3. Position a green soap strip (stem) in the mould and pour the blue soap around it.
4. Insert the daisy embeds into the blue soap once a skin has formed.
5. Pour a final layer of blue soap and allow to solidify completely for 24 hours.

recipes.name: Stephenson Ultra Clear Soap Base & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Thematic shark soaps featuring realistic sea wave swirls and embedded toy sharks. Formulated with clear and white soap bases for a multi-colored aesthetic.
recipes.process:
1. Melt clear and white soap bases. Color the clear base with blue mica.
2. Layer and swirl the blue and white soaps in individual moulds at 125°F to create wave effects.
3. Insert toy sharks into the swirled soap once a thick skin has formed.
4. Reheat clear soap base, color deep blue, and pour a final thin layer over the sharks.
5. Allow to solidify completely before use.

recipes.name: Stephenson Oatmeal And Shea Melt And Pour & Stephenson Ultra Clear Soap Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Soothing soap bars featuring dried chamomile flowers and oatmeal. Formulated with a shea-oat soap base for a creamy, skin-conditioning lather.

ingredients.name: Stephenson Oatmeal And Shea Melt And Pour

recipes.process:
1. Place dried chamomile herbs in the bottom of each mould cavity.
2. Melt a small portion of clear soap base and pour a thin layer over the herbs to secure them. Allow to set.
3. Melt the oatmeal-shea soap base and incorporate chamomile fragrance and extract.
4. Pour the white soap over the clear layer once cooled to 125°F.
5. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Shaving Melt And Pour Base & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: A high-performance exfoliating soap featuring ground pumice and poppy seeds. Designed for intensive hand and foot cleaning with a skin-conditioning shaving soap base.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the shaving soap base and incorporate fragrance and green jojoba beads.
2. Pour into moulds and allow to set.
3. Melt white soap base and incorporate poppy seeds and ground pumice (dispersed in alcohol).
4. Pour the exfoliating white layer over the set base once cooled to 125°F.
5. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour & Clear Melt And Pour Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Modern geometric soaps featuring vibrant neon green swirled layers. Formulated for high transparency and a bright citrus fragrance.
recipes.process:
1. Melt white soap base and incorporate fragrance. Pour into a corner of the mould to create an angled layer and allow to set.
2. Melt clear soap base and color with neon green mica.
3. Pour the green soap over the set white layer, ensuring the mould remains at an angle.
4. Spritz with alcohol after each pour to ensure layer adhesion.
5. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before slicing into geometric bars.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour & Clear Melt And Pour Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Decorative soaps featuring intricate Celtic knot details. Formulated with clear soap base and evergreen mica for a traditional high-coverage aesthetic.
recipes.process:
1. Disperse green mica in alcohol and incorporate into melted clear soap base.
2. Use a precision tool to fill the intricate knot details of a mould with the green soap.
3. Once the details have set, pour a secondary layer of clear or white soap over the top.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely for 4 hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Shea Melt And Pour Base & Clear Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Miniature soap truffles featuring brown, white, and pink shades. Formulated with shea butter and clear soap base for a high-lather, moisture-rich bath treatment.
recipes.process:
1. Melt portions of shea and clear soap bases. Color with brown oxide and pink dyes.
2. Incorporate butter mints fragrance and color stabilizer.
3. Pour the liquid soaps into spherical moulds and spritz with alcohol.
4. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.
5. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap to prevent glycerin dew.

recipes.name: Honey Melt And Pour Soap & White Melt And Pour Soap Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Thematic football-shaped soaps featuring intricate white and brown details. Formulated for a high-lather experience and a professional-grade aesthetic.
recipes.process:
1. Melt a small portion of white soap base and use a precision tool to fill the football lace details of a mould. Allow to set.
2. Melt the main soap base, color with brown oxide, and incorporate fragrance.
3. Pour the brown soap over the set white details once cooled to 130°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base & Shea Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Sophisticated heart-themed soap bars featuring black charcoal and rose-gold layers. Formulated for high transparency and effective mineral-based cleansing.
recipes.process:
1. Melt clear soap base and divide into portions. Color with activated charcoal (black) and rose-gold mica (pink).
2. Layer the black and pink soaps sequentially in a loaf mould, allowing each layer to set and spritzing with alcohol between pours.
3. Use a precision tool to embed a soap heart into the central layer if desired.
4. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before slicing into geometric bars.

recipes.name: Shea Melt And Pour Base & Clear Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: DIY Star Anise Melt & Pour Bar Tutorial from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Base & Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Seasonal pie-shaped soaps featuring ground pumpkin seeds and cinnamon. Formulated with goat milk soap base for a creamy lather and a festive autumn fragrance.

ingredients.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour Base
Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt a portion of white soap base, color light brown, and pour into individual cavities to create the "crust" layer. Allow to set.
2. Melt goat milk base, color with orange color block, and incorporate pumpkin pie fragrance and ground pumpkin seeds.
3. Pour the orange soap over the crust layer once cooled to 130°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and dust the surface with ground cinnamon before final solidification.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour & Goat Milk Melt And Pour Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Soothing soap bars featuring goat milk base and lavender essential oil. Designed for a creamy lather and gentle hair and skin cleansing with a traditional purple aesthetic.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the goat milk soap base and color with lavender mica (dispersed in alcohol).
2. Incorporate the essential oil and stir thoroughly.
3. Pour into rectangular moulds and spritz with alcohol.
4. Allow to solidify for 4 hours before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Unique soap bars featuring realistic Thai tea swirls. Formulated with orange-brown and white soap bases for a multi-colored aesthetic and a sweet tea fragrance.
recipes.process:
1. Melt two portions of soap base. Color one orange-brown and leave the other white.
2. Incorporate the fragrance and color stabilizer into both portions.
3. Pour the orange-brown soap into a loaf mould, then quickly pour the white soap from a height to create swirled patterns.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify for 4 hours.
5. Slice into bars once completely cool.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base Clear & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Decorative soaps featuring intricate animal-print designs. Formulated with multi-colored soap bases for a visually striking, professional-grade aesthetic.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base Clear

recipes.process:
1. Melt small portions of soap base and color for animal print patterns (spots, stripes, etc.).
2. Use a precision tool to fill the pattern details of a mould. Allow to set.
3. Pour a contrasting base soap over the set details once it has cooled to 130°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely for 20 minutes before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Isopropyl Alcohol & Honey Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: A sophisticated swirled soap featuring gold and white layers. Scented with ginger-patchouli fragrance and formulated for a rich, creamy lather with high emolliency.
recipes.process:
1. Melt the honey soap base and color with gold mica. Pour half into a mould and allow to set.
2. Melt the white soap base and divide into two portions. Color one pastel yellow.
3. Spritz the set gold layer with alcohol, then layer and swirl the white and yellow soaps over it at 135°F.
4. Reheat and pour the remaining gold soap as a final layer.
5. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before slicing.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour Base & Honey Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Butter
recipes.description: Intricate butterfly-shaped soaps featuring multi-colored orange and black details. Formulated with honey and white soap bases for high emolliency and high transparency.
recipes.process:
1. Color a small portion of honey soap base black. Fill the butterfly wing vein details using an injector tool.
2. Melt white soap base, color orange, and fill the wing cells.
3. Melt the main white soap base and color with a light blue-green hue. Pour over the set details once cooled to 130°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to harden for several hours.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour & White Melt And Pour Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Decorative clam-shell soaps featuring realistic shell textures and multi-colored iridescent layers. Designed for a high-effervescence and skin-softening soak.
recipes.process:
1. Create a thin blue mica base layer in the mould. Allow to set.
2. Pour an aqua mica layer over the base at 130°F and allow to harden.
3. Use a fork to carve deep texture lines into the set layers.
4. Pour a thin pink mica layer over the texture, ensuring the lines are filled.
5. Fill the remainder of the mould with blue mica soap and allow to solidify completely.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: A decorative meadow-themed soap featuring grated soap grass. Formulated with clear soap base and a fresh grass fragrance for a vibrant green aesthetic.
recipes.process:
1. Create the base layer: Color melted clear base green and pour into a loaf mould. Allow to set.
2. Create the grass: Melt clear base, color green, and allow to solidify in a separate mould. Once set, grate into fine strips using a cheese grater.
3. Spritz the base layer with alcohol and cover with the grated soap grass.
4. Secure the grass with a final thin pour of clear soap if desired.
5. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour Soap Base & Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Thematic Valentine's soap featuring gold arrows and pink-and-red hearts. Formulated with white and clear soap bases for a multi-textured, sparkly aesthetic.

ingredients.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base
White Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Use an injector tool to fill arrow details with gold mica soap and heart details with red and pink glitter soaps. Allow to set.
2. Melt the white soap base and incorporate strawberry fragrance.
3. Pour the white soap over the set details once it has cooled to 130°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify for 4 hours.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour & Shea Melt And Pour Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: A multi-layered soap featuring clarifying clays and activated charcoal. Scented with peppermint and rosemary for an energizing, mineral-rich cleanse.
recipes.process:
1. Layer 1: Melt clear base and color with activated charcoal. Pour 10 oz. into a mould and allow to set.
2. Layer 2: Melt shea soap base and incorporate poppy seeds. Pour 10 oz. over the first layer once cooled to 125°F.
3. Layer 3: Melt a blend of shea and clear bases, color with zeolite clay and spirulina. Pour over the second layer.
4. Spritz with alcohol between each pour to ensure adhesion.
5. Allow the loaf to solidify completely before slicing.

recipes.name: Goat Milk Melt And Pour & Clear Melt And Pour Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Vibrant, multi-colored gingerbread man soaps featuring distinct pastel hues. Formulated with goat milk and clear soap bases for a smooth, skin-softening lather.
recipes.process:
1. Melt portions of goat milk and clear bases in varying ratios to achieve specific color saturation.
2. Incorporate the fragrances and color blocks for red, yellow, teal, and blue shades.
3. Use a precision tool to fill the gingerbread man details with the colored soaps.
4. Once set, fill the remainder of the moulds with a contrasting base.
5. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely.

recipes.name: White Melt And Pour & Clear Melt And Pour Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Thematic dog-shaped soaps featuring multi-colored heart and tongue details. Formulated with white and clear soap bases for a gentle, family-friendly bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Use an injector tool to fill heart and tongue details with red mica soap. Allow to set.
2. Melt white soap base, color with blue oxide, and incorporate fragrance.
3. Pour the blue soap over the set details once cooled to 120°F.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely for 4 hours.

recipes.name: Honey Melt & Pour Soap* & Goat Milk Melt & Pour Soap Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: DIY Domino Soap Video Tutorial from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Base & White Melt And Pour Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Decorative soaps featuring embedded soap leaves. Formulated with clear soap base and a fresh apple fragrance for a vibrant seasonal aesthetic.
recipes.process:
1. Create soap leaf embeds by pouring colored soap base into a flat tray, then cutting out leaf shapes using templates or craft knives.
2. Melt clear soap base and incorporate red apple fragrance.
3. Pour a base layer into a loaf mould and allow to set slightly.
4. Arrange the soap leaves in a pile on the base layer and secure them with a final pour of clear soap.
5. Allow to solidify completely before unmoulding.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Solution
recipes.description: Intricate bicycle-themed soaps featuring hand-painted mica details. Formulated with white and clear soap bases for high transparency and a professional finish.
recipes.process:
1. Use an injector tool to fill the bicycle details of a mould with colored soap base. Allow to set.
2. Melt white soap base and incorporate fragrance.
3. Pour the white soap over the set details once cooled to 130°F.
4. Once solidified, unmould and use a fine brush to hand-paint the bicycle features with metallic gold or turquoise micas.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base & White Melt And Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Cosmic-themed soap bars featuring swirled galaxy effects and reflective glitter. Formulated with clear and white soap bases for high transparency and a vibrant intergalactic aesthetic.

ingredients.name: White Melt And Pour Soap Base
Clear Melt And Pour Soap Base

recipes.process:
1. Melt portions of clear and white soap bases. Color with black oxide and iridescent glitter.
2. Incorporate the blackberry-mango fragrance blend.
3. Layer and swirl the colored soaps in a loaf mould at 125°F to create planetary scenes.
4. Spritz with alcohol and allow to solidify completely.
5. Slice into bars and wrap immediately in plastic wrap.

recipes.name: White M&p Soap Base & Clear M&p Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: DIY How to Make Petit Four Soap Video from Soap Queen.

recipes.name: Clear Soap Base & White Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Thematic soap bars featuring embedded toy ducks in a whipped frosting base. Formulated with clear and white soap bases for a multi-textured, playful bath experience.
recipes.process:
1. Melt two portions of clear soap base and color with varying blue and green dyes to create "water" layers. Pour into a loaf mould.
2. Create soap frosting: Melt white soap base and whip with an electric mixer until fluffy peaks form.
3. Quickly apply the soap frosting over the water layers.
4. Nestle rubber duck toy embeds into the whipped frosting before it sets.
5. Allow to solidify for one hour before slicing into bars.

recipes.name: Clear Melt & Pour Soap Base & White Melt & Pour Soap Base Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Elegant 3D soaps featuring intricate swirled designs and metallic mica highlights. Formulated with clear and white soap bases for high-coverage detail and high emolliency.
recipes.process:
1. Melt clear soap base and incorporate gold mica and fragrance.
2. Alternate pouring clear-gold and white soaps into a 3D mould, using a skewer to create swirled patterns.
3. Spritz with alcohol between layers.
4. Once solidified, unmould and use a dry brush to apply gold mica over the raised design details for a traditional finish.

recipes.name: Clear Melt And Pour Soap & White Melt And Pour Soap Cleansing Bar
recipes.description: Festive candy-cane shaped soaps featuring twisted white and red strands. Formulated with peppermint essential oil for a refreshing scent and a sparkly eco-glitter finish.
recipes.process:
1. Melt white soap base and incorporate peppermint oil. Pour into a flat tray and allow to set until warm and pliable.
2. Slice the pliable soap into thin strips.
3. Layer two strips of white and two strips of red (pre-made) soap and twist them together to form a candy cane shape.
4. Dip the twisted canes into melted clear soap base containing silver eco-glitter.
5. Allow to harden completely in a hanging position or flat on a silicone mat.

ingredients.name: Mixture Of Buriti, Tamanu, Black Current, Kukuinut, And Seabuckthorn
